notable.note: The most useful thing in this file is the client agreement being read aloud almost in full, which puts the contract terms on the record: services are the onboarding call, an optional group workout, weekly check-in form submissions, one-to-one text and voice notes with Trevor, Primal nutrition, mobility and flexibility, a workout log, community access and a performance reward credit worth "500 bucks towards the three grand of the additional" six months. Exclusions named: medical advice, psychological counselling, coach's right to modify the programme, NO REFUNDS, non-transferability, waiver release and a medical disclaimer. The no-refunds clause directly contradicts the scripted OB objection play, which offers "put down a deposit, go talk to her, full refund if she says no". Also on record: an injury mid-programme pauses and extends the six months, Trevor takes roughly 20 new clients a month and has over a thousand men in the community, and the rep has never met Trevor in person and was hired by someone else on the team. Process quality on this call was markedly better than the same rep's other close the same day — the agreement was genuinely walked through rather than waved past.
